preconditions.condition: The cut on the skin pad must be clearly visible to the examiner.
preconditions.source_reference: Look at the cut on the skin pad.
preconditions.vqa_question: Is the cut on the skin pad clearly visible?

observable_cues: visual features of the cut clearly presented to the camera
limitations: Requires optimal lighting and camera angle.

postconditions.condition: The examiner has evaluated the cut for redness, swelling, and leakage.
postconditions.source_reference: Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.
postconditions.vqa_question: Has the user looked at the cut and is it free of redness, swelling, or leakage?

limitations: Visual inspection cannot confirm the absence of leakage if it is not currently active, nor can it objectively differentiate pathological redness/swelling from normal appearance without expert baseline.

error_criteria.violation_condition: The user fails to inspect the cut thoroughly for all three indicators (redness, swelling, or leaking).
error_criteria.compliance_condition: Visual evidence shows the user focused on the wound area with sufficient duration and angle to inspect.
error_criteria.compliance_question: Does the user inspect the wound for all three specified conditions?
error_criteria.source_reference: Check that it is not red, swollen or leaking.

observable_cues: user gaze directed at the cut
limitations: System cannot verify inspection behavior without continuous video or gaze data.

in_progress_criteria: The examiner's face or gaze is directed toward the skin pad.
The examiner is stationary near the pad.
action_updates.skip_impact: Infection or complications may go unnoticed if the wound assessment is skipped.
review_notes: The instruction 'Look at' and 'Check that' are subjective clinical evaluations; the VLM can only describe current visual state (color, shape), not the clinical finding or the thoroughness of the examiner's cognitive check.

preconditions.condition: A non-stick pad is available to the user.
preconditions.source_reference: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut
preconditions.vqa_question: Is a non-stick pad available in the workspace?

observable_cues: visual appearance of the dressing material
limitations: Requires the object to be in the field of view.

postconditions.condition: The non-stick pad covers the entire cut on the skin pad.
postconditions.source_reference: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut on the skin pad.
postconditions.vqa_question: Does the non-stick pad completely cover the cut on the skin pad?

observable_cues: non-stick pad bounding box contains the cut bounding box
limitations: Occlusion may prevent verifying if the pad is centered or fully covering the cut underneath.

error_criteria.violation_condition: The non-stick pad is applied such that part of the cut is exposed.
error_criteria.compliance_condition: The cut is entirely covered by the non-stick pad.
error_criteria.compliance_question: Is the entire cut covered by the non-stick pad?
error_criteria.source_reference: Place a non-stick pad over the whole cut

observable_cues: cut edges visible outside the perimeter of the pad

in_progress_criteria: The user is holding the non-stick pad near the skin pad.
The non-stick pad is approaching the target area.
action_updates.skip_impact: The cut remains exposed to environmental contaminants.

preconditions.condition: The zip bag must be open to receive the pad wrapper.
preconditions.source_reference: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it.

limitations: Difficult to verify if the zip bag is open if viewed from certain angles.

postconditions.condition: The pad wrapper is inside the zip bag and the bag is sealed.
postconditions.source_reference: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it.
postconditions.vqa_question: Is the pad wrapper inside the zip bag and is the bag sealed?

limitations: Verification of 'sealed' status is limited by image resolution.

error_criteria.violation_condition: The pad wrapper is not inside the zip bag or the bag remains unsealed.
error_criteria.compliance_condition: The pad wrapper is inside the bag and the seal line is engaged.
error_criteria.compliance_question: Is the pad wrapper fully inside the closed bag?
error_criteria.source_reference: Put the pad wrapper into the zip bag and seal it.

observable_cues: wrapper location relative to bag interior
limitations: Image resolution may not be sufficient to confirm a 'sealed' status versus just closed.

in_progress_criteria: The user is moving the pad wrapper toward the zip bag.
The zip bag is manipulated to be opened or closed.
action_updates.skip_impact: Waste disposal is incomplete, potentially leaving contaminated wrappers in the workspace.
